description: Independent Astra and Claude bilingual editions, with Sol research and separate review.

articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Source review follows NSF’s November 19, 2026 update, the original October 27 Heriot-Watt report and the authors’ September 28 preprint. Engineering runs took place in 2024–25. The demonstrated chip combines two beams within the six-telescope CHARA array. Bright-star squared-visibility precision differs from image accuracy and faint-star performance; the observing infrastructure remains large. The journal text was inaccessible. NSF adapts the university account; independent replication, commercial savings and realised planet discoveries were not established by this review.

articles.availability_note: 核查依据NSF于2026年11月19日的更新、赫瑞瓦特大学10月27日原报道及作者9月28日预印本。工程观测在2024至2025年完成，芯片在六台望远镜组成的CHARA阵列内合并两束光。亮星条纹可见度平方的精度不同于成像准确度及暗星表现，观测基础设施仍然庞大。期刊正文未能访问，NSF转述大学报道；本次核查未确立独立重复验证、商业节省或实际行星发现。
